decisions.reason: Because this custom earmold is close to the firm's established hearing-technology business and the firm has strong in-house R&D and production know-how, management is likely to retain it and improve it rather than withdraw it, although the weaker website presence suggests slightly more uncertainty.

This custom in-ear earmold fits very closely with the firm's existing capabilities, customer base, and learning base, so under an absorptive-capacity logic the firm is well placed to refine it and is unlikely to take it off the market soon.

The vacuum thermoforming unit is near the firm's established equipment and laboratory workflow offering, and with broad experience, certified processes, and own R&D in a growing industry, management would usually keep such a product and build on it.
